items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Yeah, Joe Robichore and Lindsey Miles.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joe Robichore and Lindsey Miles. I see, who else? That Lindsey Miles there, there's Joe Robichore sitting beside me at the piano. That one big picture they're taking, all the employees. Let's go from left to right.
